question: Who among the following is associated with the Tabla?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Zakir Hussain**__.

__
 
• **Zakir Hussain** is an Indian tabla player, composer, percussionist, music producer and film actor.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• Popularly known as the Tabla Maestro, Ustad Zakir Hussain is arguably the most famous Tabla player in our country in the post-independence era. 
 
• He was awarded the** Padma Shri** in **1988**, and the **Padma Bhushan** in **2002**, by the Government of India presented by **President Abdul Kalam.**
 
• The pre-eminent tabla virtuoso of time, Zakir is one of the world's great musicians, esteemed as a groundbreaking collaborator, composer, and cultural icon.
 
• Born to tabla maestro, Alla Rakha and Bavi Begum in Mahim, Mumbai on March 9, 1951, **Zakir Hussain** had an inclination for playing the tabla at a very young age. 
 
• Hussain learned to play the mridang (a classical percussion instrument) from his father when he was just **3** and began performing at concerts by the age of** 12.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Hariprasad Chaurasia** is an Indian music director and classical flautist, who plays the flute, in the Hindustani classical tradition
 
• **Ustad Sultan Khan** was an Indian sarangi player and classical vocalist belonging to Sikar Gharana. He was one of the founding members of the Indian fusion group Tabla Beat Science, with Zakir Hussain and Bill Laswell. 
 
• **Ustad Amjad Ali Khan** is an Indian classical sarod player, best known for his clear and fast ekhara taans. Khan was born into a classical musical family and has performed internationally since the 1960s.
